Historic Preservation Commission Agenda
  Municipal Services Building – 633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206

Welcome to the Historic Preservation Commission meeting. The Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818)
548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing
anytime at http://www.ci.glendale.ca.us/agenda.aspx?OrganizationID=501. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please
contact the Community Development Department at (818) 548-2115 during regular business hours.

PLEASE TURN OFF ALL ELECTRONIC DEVICES WHILE INSIDE THE HEARING ROOM.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request.
Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign language
translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are
public records, will be available for review in the Community Development Department, 633 E. Broadway, RM 103, Glendale, CA 91206.

  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 21, 2019, 5:00 P.M.

  1. ROLL CALL – Chris Cragnotti, Nicholas Doom, Mike Morgan, Desiree Shier, Lorna Vartanian

  2. COMMISSION CHAIR/VICE CHAIR – Vote to determine Commission Chair and Vice Chair, who will
  each serve a term of one calendar year per Commission rotation policy.

  3. REPORT REGARDING POSTING OF AGENDA
  The agenda for this meeting was posted on or before Monday, February 18, 2019 on the bulletin board
  outside City Hall.

  4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  December 6, 2018 (Special Meeting)

  5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is limited to 5 minutes. The
  Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  6. COMMENTS FROM COMMISSIONERS

  7. PRESENTATION HONORING FORMER COMMISSIONER ARLENE VIDOR

  8. OLD BUSINESS
  None

  9. NEW BUSINESS
  a. Review of proposed ordinance revisions relating to demolition deterrence, and general clarifications
  and clean-ups (GMC Sections 2.76, 15.20, 15.22, and 30.25)
  b. Review of 2017-2018 Certified Local Government Report

  10. PLANNING DIVISION UPDATES and INFORMATIONAL BRIEFINGS
  a. Update on proposed balcony enclosures at 107 N. Columbus
  b. Update on RFP for proposed South Cumberland Heights and Casa Verdugo historic districts

  11. ADJOURNMENT
minutes_text:
City of Glendale
  Historic Preservation Commission
  Municipal Services Building, Room 105
  633 East Broadway, CA 91206

  Action Minutes of Meeting
  Thursday, February 21, 2019

Meeting called to order by Chairperson Shier at 5:11 p.m.

1. Roll Call:
  Present: Cragnotti, Morgan, Shier, Vartanian
  Absent: None
  Late: Doom (Arrived at 5:39 p.m.)

2. Commission Chair & Vice Chair – Vote to determine Commission Chair and Vice Chair, who will each
  serve a term of one calendar year per Commissioner Rotation policy.

  New Chair:  Vartanian
  New Vice-Chair: Cragnotti

  Moved by: Commissioner Morgan
  Seconded: Commissioner Shier

  Ayes:  Cragnotti, Morgan, Shier, Vartanian,
  No:  None
  Abstain:  None

3. REPORT REGARDING POSTING OF AGENDA
  The agenda for this meeting was posted on or before January 18, 2019 on the bulletin board, outside
  City Hall.

4. Approval of Minutes: December 6, 2018 (Special Meeting)

  Moved by: Commissioner Shier
  Seconded: Commissioner Morgan

  Aye:  Morgan, Vartanian, Shier
  No:  None
  Absent:  Doom
  Abstain:  Cragnotti (Absent from last meeting)

5. Oral Communications:

  Arlene Vidor, Arts and Culture Commissioner and the president of Brand Associates, announced an
  upcoming event on October 4, 2019 celebrating the 50th anniversary of the new art gallery wing of the
  Brand Library. She also announced she is preparing a National Register of Historic Places application
  for the Brand Library and Arts Center.
 Historic Preservation Commission Minutes  2
February 21, 2019

6. Comments from Commissioners:
  • Commissioner Morgan asked to adjourn tonight’s meeting in memory of Keith Palmer, who worked
  as a planner for the city for forty years and contributed significantly to the city during his tenure.

  •  Commissioner Morgan also announced that Sunday, February 24th is the 106th anniversary of the
  founding of Montrose and that the Historical Society of the Crescenta Valley would have special
  material in celebration at the Montrose Farmers Market that day.

  •  An announcement was also made regarding Glendale Beautiful’s Arbor Day celebration on
  March 5th.

7. Old Business: None

8. New Business

  a. Review of proposed ordinance revisions relating to demolition deterrence, and general clarifications
  and clean-ups (GMC Sections 2.76, 15.20, 15.22, and 30.25)

  Speaker: Steve Hunt (The President of Glendale Historic Society)

  Staff member Jay Platt updated the commissioners on proposed ordinance changes relating to the
  deterrence of illegal demolitions and other proposed cleanups and clarifications.

  b. Review of 2017-2018 Certified local Government Report

9. Planning Division Updates and Informational Briefings

  a. Update on proposed balcony enclosures at 107 N. Columbus

  b. Update on RFP for proposed South Cumberland Heights and Casa Verdugo historic districts

10. Adjournment: 7: 10 p.m.

  _______________________________________
  Chairperson – Historic Preservation Commission
